secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to sign JWT auth tokens for user sessions. Auto-generated for development.

secrets.name: PHONE_NUMBER
secrets.description: Legacy — no longer used. QR pairing is per-user per-bot.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe API secret key from https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys. Required for billing/checkout to work.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...) from https://dashboard.stripe.com/webhooks. Required to process subscription events.

secrets.name: STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_ID
secrets.description: Stripe recurring Price ID for the Pro plan ($9/mo). Create in Stripe Products and copy the price_... ID.

secrets.name: STRIPE_BUSINESS_PRICE_ID
secrets.description: Stripe recurring Price ID for the Business plan ($29/mo). Create in Stripe Products and copy the price_... ID.
